sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Rohit Ranjan Agarwal,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel for the State.
2. A case under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 has been registered against the petitioner.
in which penalty of Rs. two lacs has been imposed.

Against the order imposing penalty, an appeal has been preferred by the petitioner in which an application for waiver of deposit of statutory penalty, which has been partly allowed and the Court below had directed that 50% of the penalty was to be deposited before the appeal would be heard and 50% of the penalty was stayed.
